grandparade_owner.text: Grand Parade is wide because it was built on filled-in river channels. The Lee is still down there, grumbling.
In Cork it is Barry's Tea or nothing. It has been made here since 1901. Lyons is a Dublin tea, and I would never say it to your face.

then.text: Another cup? You are a hard woman to refuse. Go on.

else.text: Here, a cup on the house. I only ask that you never say 'Lyons'.
